items.label: Maximize Door Space Utilization
items.value: This 5 section over the door organizer features dimensions of 14.9"×6.5"×51.6"(38cm×16.5cm×131cm) with five large window pockets and four side pockets to efficiently use the storage space behind your door (1.4"-1.8" thick)

items.label: Easy to Access
items.value: Enhanced visibility from clear-view front pockets and a wide opening offer quick identification and hassle-free access. A reduced-depth upper pocket simplifies retrieving items from its bottom. Four side pockets give additional storage space.

items.label: Versatile Use
items.value: Perfect for bedrooms, bathrooms, laundry, and closets. Holds diapers, bottles, tissues, skincare, makeup, hair tools, hats, toiletries, and more. Keeps daily essentials organized and easily within reach

items.label: Premium Material & Sturdy Structure
items.value: Made from premium non-woven fabric, PVC windows, internal rods, and cardboard bases, the over the door storage is stable and anti-tilt. with a heavy load of 40 lbs(18kg), perfect for long-term use

items.label: Foldable Design
items.value: When not in use, the behind the door storage can be easily folded up and stored away, saving valuable space and making it a practical choice for those looking to declutter without sacrificing storage capacity

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: Storing diapers, bag, towel, clothing, and more
